BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.00.title: The Unborn Cradle
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.01.title: The Skin of Bolívar
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.01.descri: The uncharted land offers itself to its new master.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.02.title: The Sweet Wound
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.02.descri: The blade cuts, and original sin pours forth with the sweetness.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.03.title: The Hollow Blood Veins
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.03.descri: When the red gold bathes in sunlight, the whole land glitters.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.04.title: The Victim's Humus
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.04.descri: If the land cannot soothe your wrath, then take my blood and bones.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.05.title: The Skull of Kharanduu
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.05.descri: Some wounds never heal. Some anger never subsides.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.06.title: The Confluence
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.06.descri: The Beast Lords welcome your arrival.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.07.title: What the Blind See
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ZONE_ENTRY.07.descri: Here, everything touched by light and shadow is an illusion.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.MOVE.inspection: You can only inspect the map right now
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.MOVE.blocked: Complete the encounters along the route first
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.AP.caption: Action Points
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.ENEMY_INTEL.title: Enemy Intelligence
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.PASSAGE.message:
Take the passage to its paired Bosky Passage?
Teleporting costs no additional action points. You may also stay here and continue on foot.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SPECIAL_COMBAT.unava: The dedicated battle is not implemented yet. Entry is unavailable.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.HUNT.title: The Hunt
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.HUNT.message:
Your action points are gone. They have caught you.
Face your fears in a challenging special battle.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.MOVEMENT.title: Movement Mode
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.MOVEMENT.warning: Running out of AP before the [color=#e97c79]Path's End[/color] triggers a [color=#e97c79]Hunt[/color].
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.MOVEMENT.confirm: Spend all remaining Action Points and trigger a Hunt?
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.MOVEMENT.walk_descri: Follow [color=#26b8a8]connected[/color] nodes, spending one Action Point per step.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.FLOOR_EXIT.PATH.desc: You follow the strange, glowing paw prints and find them. Their sizes and ages differ, yet they are clearly the same cat. Only one of them will speak to you. “You found the marks I left,” it says. “So this time and place no longer hold your interest. Want to see what comes next? Then go there.”
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.FLOOR_EXIT.PATH.acce: Obtain 1 precious Processed Part, carry over remaining Action Points, and enter the next area.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.FLOOR_EXIT.PATH.leav: A shortcut is not always the best route.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.FLOOR_EXIT.FINAL.des: Deep in the forest, you discover a black pool. A shimmering film of oil hides its depths. Jagged stones surround it like the teeth of a vicious hound. You do not know where it leads. Perhaps the way to escape the pursuing hounds is to step into another hound’s jaws.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.FLOOR_EXIT.FINAL.acc: Obtain 1 Processed Part, consume all Action Points, and enter the next area.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.FLOOR_EXIT.FINAL.lea: Now is not the time to explore its secrets.
